test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_group_by_limit_dynamic_filter.parquet', Parquet) SELECT (number % 100000) + 100000 * ((intDiv(number, 100000) * 37 + 11) % 200) AS k, toString(number % 1000) AS s, if(number % 1000 = 0, 1 + intDiv(number, 1000) % 9, 0) AS m FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT k, s, count() FROM file('test_parquet_group_by_limit_dynamic_filter.parquet') GROUP BY k, s LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8, enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic} FORMAT Null

SELECT k, count() FROM file('test_parquet_group_by_limit_dynamic_filter.parquet') GROUP BY k ORDER BY k DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8, enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic} FORMAT Null

SELECT m, count() FROM file('test_parquet_group_by_limit_dynamic_filter.parquet') GROUP BY m LIMIT 5 SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_parsing_threads = 8, enable_group_by_top_k_dynamic_filtering = {dynamic} FORMAT Null
